blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Same company, thinner desk
blocks.body:
**Web Author** is Oxygen in a browser tab. Same company as the desktop app (Syncro Soft). You still see a page view. You can still type. You can still see a red error.

It is not the full desk. Do not expect every add-on, every publish button, or a completeness check that matches last week.

Use it when you are away from the licensed desktop, or when someone only needs to read a page and leave a comment. Do not send a writer into a browser tab and then ask them for a local WebHelp folder.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You never opened the desktop app or the mock, or you wrote that the browser tab can do every desktop job.

Expected: Six factual lines. Web Author is Oxygen in a browser. The desktop app is still the full desk.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Open kitepump.ditamap on the desktop app so you have a baseline. Look at Author view on one page.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Read the official Web Author page from the Source box (or the video catalog). If your shop has a Web Author URL, open it. If not, use the labeled mock in this lesson.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write three things the browser app still has: a page view, a way to see errors, a writing toolbar. Check the labels. Write “verify” next to any label you guessed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Write three things the desktop app still does that the browser tab may not: the booklet view with a completeness check, local publish, work with no internet.

blocks.summary: Six factual lines. Web Author is Oxygen in a browser. The desktop app is still the full desk.

options: Oxygen in a browser tab, from the same company as the desktop app

blocks.why: Web Author is still Oxygen. It lives in a browser. It is a thinner desk, not a different kind of page.

blocks.q: You need to run a completeness check on the booklet and read a local publish log. Where do you work?
options: Only in a browser tab :  it can do every desktop job
blocks.why: The browser cousin is for writing and light review. Completeness and local publish still live on the desktop.
